purpose: Draft justifications to enter beside each scanned tool in OpenAI review. Values describe the declared local inventory; compare with live tools/list and observed behavior before submission. These do not override server annotations.

list_orgs.readOnlyHint: Lists authorized org records without changing them.
list_orgs.destructiveHint: No org, metadata or record is removed or overwritten.
list_orgs.openWorldHint: Lists MTDT's stored org connection records; it does not request an arbitrary external destination.

resolve_target.readOnlyHint: Ranks accessible org connection records for a query.
resolve_target.destructiveHint: Target lookup does not change the target.
resolve_target.openWorldHint: Matches MTDT's stored org labels and connection information.

list_deployments.readOnlyHint: Reads the team's deployment history and latest recorded run.
list_deployments.destructiveHint: Does not create, change or cancel runs.
list_deployments.openWorldHint: Returns deployment records held by MTDT.

get_deploy_status.readOnlyHint: Reads an existing deployment's latest run result.
get_deploy_status.destructiveHint: Status inspection does not change a run or org.

await_deploy_status.readOnlyHint: Waits for a recorded run to become terminal without starting a new run.
await_deploy_status.destructiveHint: Waiting does not deploy or delete metadata.
await_deploy_status.openWorldHint: Polls the existing run's MTDT status.

check_deployment_creation_status.readOnlyHint: Reads population state and related task results for an existing deployment.
check_deployment_creation_status.destructiveHint: Does not recreate the deployment or retry a failed task.
check_deployment_creation_status.openWorldHint: Reports MTDT's stored deployment and task state.

prepare_deployment_run_selected_items_ob.readOnlyHint: True: legacy type/name normalizer only; builds an object without saving composition or starting a run. Its output is no longer a launch argument; save components with add_deployment_components.
prepare_deployment_run_selected_items_ob.destructiveHint: The returned selection alone changes no metadata.
prepare_deployment_run_selected_items_ob.openWorldHint: Builds an MTDT selection from supplied names and known type mappings.

preflight_deployment.readOnlyHint: True: checks the saved composition by default, including saved deletions/timing; optional explicit selections are advisory only and do not save a draft or launch it.
preflight_deployment.destructiveHint: Findings describe possible effects but do not execute deletions or overwrites.
preflight_deployment.openWorldHint: Full checks can query the connected Salesforce target org.

run_impact_analysis.readOnlyHint: Inspects dependencies of a proposed metadata selection.
run_impact_analysis.destructiveHint: Dependency inspection does not deploy or delete components.
run_impact_analysis.openWorldHint: Full dependency analysis can query the connected Salesforce source org.

check_target_conflicts.readOnlyHint: Compares selected items with current target state.
check_target_conflicts.destructiveHint: Conflict detection does not overwrite the target.
check_target_conflicts.openWorldHint: Reads live modification information from the connected Salesforce target org.

recommend_tests.readOnlyHint: True: computes recommendations for the saved selection by default, falling back to the latest run only for legacy drafts without saved selection.
recommend_tests.destructiveHint: A recommendation neither executes tests nor deploys metadata.
recommend_tests.openWorldHint: Uses retrieved metadata and selection information held by MTDT.

get_task_status.readOnlyHint: Reads a task's current status and result.
get_task_status.destructiveHint: Does not start, cancel or delete tasks.

get_workflow_deployment_recipe.readOnlyHint: Returns the server's deployment workflow guidance.
get_workflow_deployment_recipe.destructiveHint: Guidance does not execute any action.
get_workflow_deployment_recipe.openWorldHint: Returns the recipe supplied by MTDT.

get_full_metadata_deployment_comparison_.readOnlyHint: Reads the status of an existing comparison.
get_full_metadata_deployment_comparison_.destructiveHint: Status inspection does not modify metadata or start another comparison.
get_full_metadata_deployment_comparison_.openWorldHint: Returns the recorded MTDT comparison status.

get_latest_full_metadata_deployment_comp.readOnlyHint: Lists comparison records for a deployment.
get_latest_full_metadata_deployment_comp.destructiveHint: Listing does not replace or delete comparison results.
get_latest_full_metadata_deployment_comp.openWorldHint: Reads comparison records stored in MTDT.

list_metadata_backups.readOnlyHint: Lists stored backup metadata and source usability.
list_metadata_backups.destructiveHint: Does not create, restore or delete a backup.
list_metadata_backups.openWorldHint: Reads MTDT backup records and stored archive availability.

list_git_repos.readOnlyHint: Lists the team's connected repository records.
list_git_repos.destructiveHint: Does not write a commit or change a repository connection.
list_git_repos.openWorldHint: Lists repository connections stored in MTDT rather than fetching arbitrary Git URLs.

create_deployment.readOnlyHint: False: creates a draft and population tasks; optional project_id/work_item_ids also attach cards in the same call. Late link failure preserves deploymentId with confirmed/unconfirmed IDs.
create_deployment.destructiveHint: True: the tool modifies data in MTDT, and the Claude directory requires destructiveHint for any data-modifying tool. It creates a deployment record; it does not by itself overwrite or delete target org metadata.
create_deployment.openWorldHint: False in the declared inventory: the operation creates an internal MTDT deployment. Confirm the boundary of asynchronous population in the live review.

set_deployment_description.readOnlyHint: False: writes the existing deployment's description.
set_deployment_description.destructiveHint: True: the tool modifies data in MTDT, and the Claude directory requires destructiveHint for any data-modifying tool. It overwrites the stored deployment description; it does not change Salesforce metadata.
set_deployment_description.openWorldHint: Updates the stored MTDT description; it does not directly push a Git commit.

create_deployment_run.readOnlyHint: False: creates a validation or real deployment task from the full saved config, using its components, overrides, deletions and execution settings.
create_deployment_run.destructiveHint: True: a real run can overwrite or delete target metadata and execute saved Apex, job or post-deploy actions. Review them in preview_deployment_run first; composition is not passed inline.
create_deployment_run.openWorldHint: Runs the operation against the connected Salesforce target org.

quick_deploy.readOnlyHint: False: starts a real deployment from a successful validation.
quick_deploy.destructiveHint: True: deploys the validated package and can overwrite target metadata.
quick_deploy.openWorldHint: Deploys to the connected Salesforce target org.

run_metadata_backup.readOnlyHint: False: creates a backup task and a new stored archive.
run_metadata_backup.destructiveHint: True: the tool modifies data in MTDT, and the Claude directory requires destructiveHint for any data-modifying tool. It creates a backup task and archive; it does not delete or overwrite org metadata.
run_metadata_backup.openWorldHint: Retrieves metadata from the connected Salesforce org and stores the archive.

start_full_metadata_deployment_compariso.readOnlyHint: False: creates a new comparison workflow and its task state.
start_full_metadata_deployment_compariso.destructiveHint: True: the tool modifies data in MTDT, and the Claude directory requires destructiveHint for any data-modifying tool. It creates a comparison run; it does not deploy or delete org metadata.
start_full_metadata_deployment_compariso.openWorldHint: The workflow can retrieve data from the connected Salesforce orgs.

browse_metadata.readOnlyHint: True: browsing only reads component lists and bodies. An uncached browse can fill MTDT's internal metadata cache, which does not change user-visible data.
browse_metadata.destructiveHint: False in the declared inventory: retrieving metadata does not overwrite or delete metadata in Salesforce.
browse_metadata.openWorldHint: An org-source browse can retrieve metadata from the connected Salesforce source org.

validate_deployment.readOnlyHint: False: creates a validation task from the saved config and stores results; this is not a read-only preview.
validate_deployment.destructiveHint: True: creates stored run state. Salesforce checkOnly does not install metadata, but saved job pauses and post-deploy Apex can still execute; inspect the preview before launch.
validate_deployment.openWorldHint: Validates the selected package with the connected Salesforce target org, including Apex test execution.

list_archives.readOnlyHint: Lists the team's registered metadata archives without changing them.
list_archives.destructiveHint: Does not create, modify or delete an archive.

request_archive_upload.readOnlyHint: False: creates a pending upload slot and a signed upload URL.
request_archive_upload.destructiveHint: True: the tool modifies data in MTDT, and the Claude directory requires destructiveHint for any data-modifying tool. It reserves a new archive slot; it does not change existing archives or Salesforce metadata.
request_archive_upload.openWorldHint: Returns an MTDT storage upload URL; it does not contact Salesforce or third parties.

register_archive.readOnlyHint: False: registers the uploaded ZIP as a new archive usable as a deployment source.
register_archive.destructiveHint: True: the tool modifies data in MTDT, and the Claude directory requires destructiveHint for any data-modifying tool. It creates an archive record; it does not change Salesforce metadata.
register_archive.openWorldHint: Reads the uploaded file from MTDT storage only.

get_deployment_components.readOnlyHint: True: reads the saved component selection, deletions and overrides without changing the draft.
get_deployment_components.destructiveHint: False: inspecting saved composition does not remove components or deploy anything.
get_deployment_components.openWorldHint: False: reads authorized MTDT deployment data, with no Salesforce call.

preview_deployment_run.readOnlyHint: True: prepares a run plan from the saved draft and optional execution options, without saving settings, view history or tasks.
preview_deployment_run.destructiveHint: False: reveals configured actions but executes none of them.
preview_deployment_run.openWorldHint: False: reads the authorized deployment; no Salesforce or other external API call is made.

add_deployment_components.readOnlyHint: False: updates the saved component selection on an authorized deployment. Repeating an already-saved add is a no-op.
add_deployment_components.destructiveHint: True: modifies stored MTDT config. It preserves manual overrides and other settings; it does not deploy or delete Salesforce metadata. Saves use the UI last-save-wins model.
add_deployment_components.openWorldHint: False: checks retrieved source components in MTDT and writes the saved config; missing components require a separate browse/retrieval.

remove_deployment_components.readOnlyHint: False: removes components from the saved deployment selection. Repeating a removal is a no-op.
remove_deployment_components.destructiveHint: True: modifies stored MTDT config. Removing a selection does not delete Salesforce metadata and keeps manual overrides available for re-add.
remove_deployment_components.openWorldHint: False: edits authorized MTDT deployment data; it does not call Salesforce.

list_projects.readOnlyHint: Reads user-authorized MTDT project/Work Item data and derives delivery state without persistent writes, tasks or RPC side effects.
list_projects.destructiveHint: Does not change cards, groups, deployments or environments.
list_projects.openWorldHint: Reads stored MTDT records with the caller RLS/MFA; no Salesforce call or arbitrary external destination.

list_project_environments.readOnlyHint: Reads user-authorized MTDT project/Work Item data and derives delivery state without persistent writes, tasks or RPC side effects.
list_project_environments.destructiveHint: Does not change cards, groups, deployments or environments.
list_project_environments.openWorldHint: Reads stored MTDT records with the caller RLS/MFA; no Salesforce call or arbitrary external destination.

list_work_items.readOnlyHint: Reads user-authorized MTDT project/Work Item data and derives delivery state without persistent writes, tasks or RPC side effects.
list_work_items.destructiveHint: Does not change cards, groups, deployments or environments.
list_work_items.openWorldHint: Reads stored MTDT records with the caller RLS/MFA; no Salesforce call or arbitrary external destination.

get_work_item.readOnlyHint: Reads user-authorized MTDT project/Work Item data and derives delivery state without persistent writes, tasks or RPC side effects.
get_work_item.destructiveHint: Does not change cards, groups, deployments or environments.
get_work_item.openWorldHint: Reads stored MTDT records with the caller RLS/MFA; no Salesforce call or arbitrary external destination.

create_work_item.readOnlyHint: False: inserts an open Work Item; ticket import returns an existing card without rewriting it.
create_work_item.destructiveHint: False: creation does not overwrite existing cards or delete data.
create_work_item.openWorldHint: True: ticket import reads the connected tracker; product lifecycle notifications can be queued.

update_work_item.readOnlyHint: False: changes card text or explicitly removes a tracker reference.
update_work_item.destructiveHint: True: may overwrite text or remove the ticket association.
update_work_item.openWorldHint: False: changes MTDT card data; it does not write to the external tracker.

archive_work_item.destructiveHint: True: removes it from the default active list without deleting history or links.
archive_work_item.openWorldHint: False: changes the stored MTDT status; normal lifecycle notifications remain product side effects.

unarchive_work_item.readOnlyHint: False: restores an archived card to open.
unarchive_work_item.destructiveHint: False: restores visibility without deleting or overwriting card history.
unarchive_work_item.openWorldHint: False: updates only the MTDT status.
